knownGaps: SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange mail and Teams are not connected in this proof of concept. They are listed as NOT searched.
iPhone texts and WhatsApp messages are out of scope.
Android texts (Phone Link) are experimental and off by default. Only recent texts are available, picture messages are not included, and it is never a search of all texts.
Bellevue's system of record is not confirmed. No portal integration is built.
The tool does not decide responsiveness, exemptions, redaction or release. Staff decide.
